name: Saint Veyra Capital
scene: The city bell is quiet this morning. Saint Veyra opens around you in black roadstone, waxlight, and paperwork that somehow feels more dangerous than wolves.

name: Hearthmere Fields
scene: Dawn fog drags itself over wheat fields and low walls. The Old Pilgrim Road runs east toward a small shrine with fresh claw marks on the signpost.
actions: travel Road Shrine of Little Dawn

name: Road Shrine of Little Dawn
scene: A candle rail circles a squat road shrine. Beneath it, a dark stair curves toward a cryptlet door fitted with a palm-sized bronze bell.

name: Pilgrim Trial Cryptlet
scene: The stair closes behind you with a bell tone that rings inward instead of out. Old road names hang from thread tags in the dark.
